article.title: After last year's storm, this remote Alaska town is still picking up the pieces
article.summary: In October, 2025, the remnants of a typhoon seriously damaged Alaska Native villages in the far western part of the state. A year later, one of the hardest hit communities is still recovering. (Image credit: Gabby Hiestand Salgado)
